items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: sometimes on the trombone I'd have Marshall Brown

ctx.x: Yeah, Jack Mayhew and Will Alger.

Yeah that band. A very nice band and there's an example of one of the places now -- in Toronto everytime I went to Toronto, I had a different band; everytime I went to Toronto, I had a different band. It was never the same; sometimes on the trombone I'd have Marshall Brown; then someone else - and the next time, somebody else because it was an impossibility to keep a steady band together.
